description: Smart contracts that compromised websites read their next stage from, as the EtherHiding contract tracker lists them: chain, kit, current destinations and when Ohey last read each one. firstSeen is the day Ohey first read the contract, not when it was deployed; many contracts share the day tracking began. nextHops holds contract addresses and WebRTC endpoints (IP:port), so only a 0x value can be looked up as a contract. A resolver contract that names further contracts in nextHops lists in destinations the hosts those contracts point to on the latest read, so the same host also appears on the row of the next contract: count hosts once across rows. destinations is empty when the next hop is a WebRTC endpoint, or, when nextHops is empty too, because Ohey has read the contract but recorded no host from it. lastChanged is when its destination last changed. Addresses are lowercase. destinations is what the latest read (lastRead) returned. Chains ending in testnet or Sepolia are test networks; kits read them like any other. nextHops values are defanged too. Set destination to find the contracts that point, or pointed, at a host or a host under it; it also matches the endpoints in nextHops. Each row then carries destinationCurrent, true when the match is in destinations or nextHops now and false when only in history. Destinations hold hosts only, so a URL filter compares its host and not its path. history holds the 20 most recent changes, so a destination older than those does not match. Page with offset; total is the full count.

chain.description: A chain name as the results write it, such as Polygon, BNB Smart Chain or Ethereum Sepolia.

destination.description: A host or URL, fanged or defanged.

kit.description: A kit slug, such as clearshort.

offset.description: Rows to skip, for paging past limit.

sort.description: tracker keeps the tracker page order; firstSeen puts the newest contracts first; lastChanged puts the most recently re-pointed first.
